auth.selected: OAuth 2 access token stored as encrypted bearer connection authority.
auth.scope_alternative_resolution: required_scopes records only scopes present in every OpenAPI security alternative; exact OR alternatives remain in each operation contract because the catalog field cannot encode them.

pagination.contract: Automatic walks require page plus page_size and one documented collection result; opaque next links remain explicit single-page gaps.

compatibility_sensitive_posture.resolution: Preserved as shipped compatibility authority; every new mutation is approval-always and every new alias/read is uncached and never approval-gated.

root_source_pin.reason: The root spans thirteen independent official documents; pinning any one would falsely claim proof for the other twelve. Every dependency leaf is exact-source pinned and this fixture reconciles the root.

source_posture.reason: PayPal financial, checkout, billing, dispute, webhook, payout, shipment, and token records are not user-work task, note, or project entities.

audit_findings_folded.finding: One OpenAPI pin cannot honestly cover PayPal split contracts.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Omitted the root pin, created thirteen exact source-pinned leaves, and hash-locked the complete docset fixture.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The order update callback reverses client and server authority.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded the merchant-hosted inbound callback instead of dispatching it to api-m.paypal.com.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Six dispute actions require multipart evidence or message bodies.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded all six until file_ref multipart request construction can preserve bytes and boundaries.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Two accounting-sync reads require PayPal invoicing/internal scope.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded both from the merchant-delegated public surface.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The legacy batch-tracking operation is deprecated only in provider prose.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded the route and retained the current Orders v2 and single-transaction tracking capabilities.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Optional PayPal-Request-Id would permit duplicate supported POST mutations.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Made it caller-owned, mandatory, CRLF-safe, and bounded to 38 single-byte characters on every new non-read operation whose official contract documents the header.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Authorization and on-behalf merchant headers are operation-level authority.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Kept bearer, PayPal-Auth-Assertion, attribution, metadata, host, and user-agent headers outside callable arguments.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Several official path-ID schemas accept delimiters, percent escapes, controls, or empty strings.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Bounds every path segment, preserves already-safe provider patterns, and replaces permissive patterns with an unreserved-character segment contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: A flat required_scopes list cannot represent PayPal OAuth scope alternatives.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Publishes only the exact intersection, preserves every OR alternative in audit evidence, and describes the limitation on each affected operation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: JSON Patch request roots cannot be represented by body.* projection.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Admitted them through required bounded array-shaped body_raw without changing wire root shape.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Large or polymorphic JSON objects can lose nested fields or unsafe integers when flattened.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses bounded object-shaped body_raw for unions, freeform, oversized, or unsafe-integer bodies and recursively closed projection otherwise.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Sensitive request fields were evidenced but not surfaced to operation callers.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Adds an explicit private-input warning to every generated operation whose pinned request schema contains financial, identity, address, account, or token material.

audit_findings_folded.finding: PayPal omits requestBody.required on revision and tracking writes that need caller input.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Requires bounded body_raw for subscription revision and single-transaction tracker creation instead of dispatching ambiguous bodyless writes.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Caller-selected Prefer changes response semantics.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Removed it from callable authority and fixed documented routes to return=representation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Blind pagination could merge links or follow unproved continuation URLs.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Automates only page/page_size contracts with one proved collection result and leaves next-link-only routes explicit.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The manual webhook-events page_size has no provider-declared numeric bounds.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps continuation manual and admits only the conservative integer range from 1 through the documented default of 10.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Filling the root with new reads would widen established default read grants.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps root additions action-only and places new reads in source-pinned dependency leaves.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Replacing the compatibility composition taxonomy would regress existing discovery paths.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserves every established composition tag and appends only the new commerce, billing, and API discovery tags.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The old compatibility surface accepted undeclared nested request keys and lossy response integers.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Added recursively closed request schemas, explicit required empty bodies, and unsafe-integer string parsing without changing established catalog contracts.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Financial mutations need differentiated destructive posture.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Marks money movement, commitment changes, dispute outcomes, and deletes destructive; all new calls require approval.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Control-plane and financial records do not prove task/note/project Source semantics.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Publishes no work_entity_sources and records the exact reason.
